responsibility: Implements the executable C hook logic for the LM32 backend that complements the static target macros in lm32.h and the RTL patterns in lm32.md. This file owns LM32-specific ABI and code-generation decisions such as whether values are returned in registers or memory, argument passing and varargs setup, frame-size computation and stack/prologue/epilogue save-restore expansion, elimination and starting-frame offsets, operand/address legitimacy, move legality, and register/mode compatibility. It also provides expansion helpers for compares/branches, block operations and PIC/small-data related address handling, target option override processing, and TARGET_RTX_COSTS estimates that guide instruction selection between native operations and libcalls based on optional LM32 features like multiply, divide, and barrel shift.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable backend implementation for the LM32 stem group: it defines TARGET hook bodies and helper routines for ABI decisions, frame layout/prologue-epilogue expansion, address legitimacy, move checking, varargs, and RTL cost modeling, wiring them into targetm. Unlike lm32.h’s macro-based target specification, lm32.md’s declarative instruction patterns/reservations, and lm32.opt’s command-line option declarations, this file contains the procedural C backend logic that consumes those interfaces and option flags.
